notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Islands and one basic Forest.
description:
Activate a basic Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Summer Bloom by paying {1}{G}, allowing you to play three more lands this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Tracker's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Summer Bloom on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, a basic Forest and any other land you control, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Play the Forest and another land from your graveyard.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tireless Tracker's first ability triggers twice, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate a Clue by paying {2} and sacrificing it.
Tireless Tracker's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Clue ability, causing you to draw Summer Bloom from the top of your library.
Repeat.
